title: Catalog polynomial control states
statement: For natural numbers $c$ and $C$, define a finite type of control states with two distinguished states, copy and setup; loop and rewind states indexed by $i\in\{0,\ldots,c\}$; advance states indexed by $i\in\{0,\ldots,c+1\}$; and emit states indexed by $j\in\{0,\ldots,C\}$.
